---
title: Add member stories to phase 4
labels: needs-info, content
---

**Context.** Phase 4 tells learners how to get hired but has no real examples. Short stories from members who got a first role or internship would help most with motivation.

**Needed.** Two or three accounts of 150 to 250 words each, with the member's permission: starting point, what they built, how long it took, what helped most and what they would do differently.

**Where to add.** `roadmap/04-get-hired.md`, or a new page linked from it.

**Done when.** At least two stories are published with consent.
